about: Curriculum card (its id and name, because some ids repeat) -> the installed member that covers the card's core capability. Only 'exact' (same name) and 'curated' (checked by hand) entries count as mapped. 'rejected' records a card that was reviewed and is not covered by any member, with the reason; it is never tested or scored, and it stops the card being suggested again. Every other card is unreviewed. A mapped card is tested against the member's own instructions, and the examiner still notes where the third-party skill it names may go further. Suggestions from card_map.py suggest are never written here unchecked.
